verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party Sandbox documentation of an idle or lifetime timeout that automatically shuts down or destroys a sandbox and stops billing. The only timeout documented is a default command timeout for a session (docs-19), which is an adjacent control and does not cover sandbox lifecycle. A community comment reports that the docs do not seem to allow auto-destroying a sandbox after idle time. Another comment's mention of Containers auto-shutdown is a secondhand, host-platform remark, not a documented Sandbox capability.
